conventions.monorepo: apps/* are deployable applications; packages/* are shared libraries consumed through npm workspaces under the @kynox scope

deployment.note: Managed Hostinger Node.js with MySQL is the documented target; apps/api serves the built apps/web SPA from a single process started by app.js under PM2 (ecosystem.config.cjs). No accepted production or UAT deployment record exists at the time of adoption, so deployment topology is documented rather than verified.

description: Kynox Inventory Intelligence — a source-neutral inventory diagnostic that ingests customer exports, normalizes them into a canonical transaction model, and serves data-quality, reconciliation, and inventory analytics.
